user.title: Bluetooth Speaker
user.description: Play to Bluetooth (A2DP) speakers from Home Assistant, no add-on needed. The machine with the Bluetooth adapter must run BlueZ and bluez-alsa, and Home Assistant must see its system D-Bus (/run/dbus). Press Submit to check.

error.no_dbus: Cannot reach the system D-Bus. Mount /run/dbus into the Home Assistant container.
error.no_adapter: BlueZ has no Bluetooth adapter. Install and start bluez on the machine with the adapter.
error.no_bluealsa: bluez-alsa is not running. Install bluez-alsa-utils and start the bluealsa service.

menu_options.scan: Scan and connect a new speaker

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: Put the speaker in pairing mode (hold its Bluetooth button until the light blinks fast) and turn Bluetooth off on phones connected to it. Press Submit to scan for {giay} seconds.

pick.title: Choose the speaker
pick.description: The first connection pairs the speaker and marks it trusted. {loi}

forget.title: Forget a speaker
forget.description: Removes the pairing; the speaker must be paired again to be used.

error.connect_failed: Could not pair or connect. Put the speaker in pairing mode and try again.

abort.nothing_found: No speaker found. Check that it is in pairing mode and close to the Bluetooth adapter, then scan again.
